statements: ALTER TABLE gsc_connection DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_gsc_connection_singleton
CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS gsc_connection_id_seq AS SMALLINT OWNED BY gsc_connection.id
SELECT setval('gsc_connection_id_seq', COALESCE((SELECT max(id) FROM gsc_connection), 0) + 1, false)
ALTER TABLE gsc_connection ALTER COLUMN id SET DEFAULT nextval('gsc_connection_id_seq')
UPDATE gsc_connection SET google_email = lower(google_email) WHERE google_email IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_gsc_connection_google_email ON gsc_connection (google_email) WHERE google_email IS NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE gsc_site_sync ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS connection_id SMALLINT REFERENCES gsc_connection(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
